outfit.name: 反击女仆特勤女仆装
outfit.prose: a playful and frilly cafe maid uniform: a short black dress with puffed shoulders, crisp white ruffled apron tied in a generous bow at the back, low-cut neckline showing ample bosom, yellow ribbon brooch, frilled white maid headband, and thigh-high lace-trimmed stockings.
